verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the version-prefixed base URL (https://router.requesty.ai/v1), which hints at a versioned API surface. Nothing in the pack describes a versioning scheme, compatibility guarantees, or any deprecation policy. Prompt-library versioning concerns prompts, not the API, so it does not count. Missing for 10: a documented API versioning policy, a published deprecation policy and timelines, a changelog or sunset notices, and independent corroboration.
